sources.title: Understanding BLIP : A Huggingface Model - GeeksforGeeks
sources.snippet: BLIP (Bootstrapping Language-Image Pre-training) is a multimodal AI model that combines computer vision and natural language processing to understand both images and text together. It is trained on large-scale image-text pairs, enabling strong performance in vision-language tasks.

sources.title: BLIP Multitask Vision-Language Codebase | GitReverse
sources.snippet: Build me a working version of this BLIP project so I can run image captioning, visual question answering, and image text retrieval from one codebase. I want a simple setup where I can install the requirements, open the demo notebook, and try the model on my own images without fighting the environment.
